Where a node still wrote Chinese (the port's simulation notes, the visual novel's title and scene names), its case's brief now says that every word is English, and the case ran again; each record's note counts every run of its canvas text and says what went wrong in the ones not published (the port's two failed model calls, the ad's first three runs). The knowledge-base case is now a canvas compiled from tasks like every other (scope and architecture; access, documents and copy in parallel; a business layer; the web workspace; review) that delivers a working knowledge-base workspace on simulated data, instead of the Chinese canvas kept from its 2026-09-04 run in AwwO's local development preview. That recorded canvas, its record builder (`publish-knowledge-base.mjs`) and its test are removed, with the cards' “UI translated from Chinese” badge and fact list and the several-field node output only it used.
- Show the 8 most recently updated canvases in the home's 「继续工作」, not 4 (owner request 2026-10-13 17:20: 首页默认多显示几张画布): two rows of four at desktop width, four rows of two on a tablet, one compact row each on a phone; 「查看全部」 still opens every canvas in place, and the placeholders while the list loads fill the same two rows.
- Keep 继续工作 as the workspace home's one canvas section again, instead of 最近的成果 (owner 2026-10-13 15:28, with the change two entries down live: 最近的成果这一栏既没有缩略图，也没有画布的预览结构，然后也没有保持住我所有操作过的案例……还不如保留那个工作中的画布更好). 最近的成果 showed a canvas only once it had delivered a result, picked from the 18 most recently updated canvases and at most 6, so most of a workspace's canvases were not on the home; its picture of a delivered page is that page rendered without scripts, empty for a page that a script draws (a 3D scene, a canvas animation); and no card showed the canvas itself. The home, the members' and the readers' alike, has 「继续工作」 again as it had this morning: the most recently updated canvases, each drawn by its own structure with its node count and when it changed, the count of every canvas, search, and 「查看全部」 for all of them in place (pages, rename, delete). The 全部画布 dialog and `HomeResults.tsx` are gone; the gallery (`ResultsGallery.tsx`) is no longer mounted, and a canvas's results stay one click away in its 「成果」 view.
- Run Claude Opus 5.5 only on a paid plan (owner decision 2026-10-13: Opus 5.5 改成只给付费用户). A model on the new setting `AWWO_PLAN_ONLY_MODELS` (empty: `bedrock.claude-opus-5-5`; `none`: no model) runs only for a workspace whose owner has Pro or Max, on credits, or that a platform administrator owns (the operator's own, which keeps every model, `operator_workspace.go`). For every other workspace, route-limited or created before route limits, it is outside the free allowance the way a paid route closed to it is (`plan_only_models.go`): the runtime and direct-task catalogues mark it `requiresUpgrade`, so every picker tags it 「· Pro」 and the canvas assistant's menu no longer lets it be picked; admission refuses a call on it with `premium_quota_exceeded` before anything is reserved, the refusal the web already answers with the way to Pro and Max (`reserveInvocation`, after a workspace's own `plan_required`); a message with pictures never moves onto it (`switchToSeeingModel`); and the components a plan adds are never put on it. The Opus 5.5 invitation in the canvas now says 「Pro / Max 专享」 and opens the plans, for any workspace without a paid plan that the server keeps it from, with no switch to make; the plans page names the exception. The operator's planner calls are never held. Other Bedrock models keep their free daily calls. Verified: a Go unit test of the setting, two Postgres tests (refused for a route-limited and a legacy free workspace, nothing reserved, Haiku 4.5 still admitted; admitted on a paid plan, charged to it, and in the operator's own workspace; the catalogue marks it for the free workspaces only; a picture's switch passes it over for a free workspace and takes it in the operator's), and 9 vitest cases.
- Keep 最近的成果 as the workspace home's one canvas section, instead of 继续工作 (owner decision 2026-10-13 12:58: 最近的成果留下，去掉继续工作, the other way round from the change below). The home, the members' and the readers' alike, shows the canvases' recent results, read from the newest canvases as the canvas list pages them (`HomeResults.tsx`), and 「全部画布」 in its header opens every canvas in a dialog, in the canvas list's own form (search, pages, rename, delete), so a canvas that has delivered nothing yet stays one click away. A workspace without canvases gets the first-canvas guide; either one carries the anchor the home's tutorial waits for and the tour points at.
- Make 云白 (Cloud) the appearance style of everyone who has not picked one (owner request 2026-10-13: 把默认风格改成云白), instead of following the system with 潮汐 / 深潜; 跟随系统 stays in the picker with that pair. Only a pick is saved now (`awwo.theme.v2`, written by the 外观 picker alone), so a later change of the default reaches everyone who never picked. The 2026-10-12 key `awwo.theme.v1` was written on every visit: its `auto` was nobody's choice and now gives 云白, while a style id there is kept as a pick. The older light/dark switch (`superclaw_theme`) is read only when that key is absent, as before (a value that differs from the system keeps 潮汐 or 深潜), and is still written with a pick. `saas.html` paints the same choice before the first paint, and 云白 when browser storage is blocked. Verified: the page script and the app agree on 16 storage and system cases; the picker starts on 云白 and saves nothing until a pick; a reader who never picked keeps 云白 when the system turns dark.
- Keep one list of canvases on the workspace home (owner request 2026-10-13: 这个继续工作，和最近的画布这里内容有点重叠保留一个就行了). 「最近的成果 / Recent results」 showed the newest canvases again, by what they delivered, right under 「继续工作 / Continue working」; the home now has 「继续工作」 alone, which reaches every canvas (its search and full list included), and a canvas's results stay one click away in its 「成果」 view. The members' and the readers' home both drop it; the gallery component is no longer mounted.
- Make the canvas assistant's box a chat app's composer (owner request 2026-10-12: 对标 Codex 和 Claude Code 的对话框，模型选择、注释都归纳一下，长注释放到用户须知里). Nothing is printed around the box any more. One toolbar inside it holds the file "+", the direct-task model as a chip (its menu, with the reasoning effort and the engine links, opens above the box; the chip still reads 「直接执行用：…」 to a screen reader and as its tooltip), 用户须知, and a round send that a round stop replaces while a message is handled. 用户须知 (`ComposerNotes.tsx`, an ⓘ that opens its notes above itself in a layer of its own, closed by a click elsewhere, Escape, a scroll or a resize) holds what used to stand under the box: the notice against personal or sensitive data (still the box's accessible description), what a message costs, and that the 「接下来」 suggestions cost nothing (no longer a chip on that card). Undo is an icon in the panel's header (in the toolbar of the welcome box, only when there is something to undo). The planner's 「pi · 画布规划」 line shows only when the planner is connecting or closed, an earlier plan is to be checked, or for the Jev planner. The box starts two lines tall and grows with its text, with no resize handle. A plan warning and the knowledge a task takes are said above the box with the task service's notices. A node's chat gets the same 用户须知 beside its model chip, holding the line that stood above its box and the data notice. Checked in Chrome with the hosted CSS (rest, typed, busy, the welcome box, both popovers).
- Put no model-level limit on a workspace a platform administrator owns (owner decision 2026-10-12: 「我是管理员，不要对我有任何模型层面的限制，默认我是最高等级用户」). A workspace an administrator creates starts with the highest run limits the tenants row accepts (100 runs at once, 100,000 a day), every model and no route limit, instead of the deployment's new-workspace defaults; and the free allowances the service counts outside that row no longer stop an administrator's workspace: free image and video generations a day (`media_quota_exceeded`), the deployment's free media ceiling (`media_capacity_exceeded`), free 3D generations (`model3d_quota_exceeded`, `model3d_capacity_exceeded`) and TypeSafe evaluations a day (`typesafe_daily_limit`). Ownership decides, not membership; deployment-wide totals still count those generations. The owner's three existing workspaces were given the same run limits through the admin PATCH the same day (`operator_workspace.go`, `resources.go`, `media_runs.go`, `typesafe.go`).
- Rebuild the eight homepage cases on Claude Opus 5.5 and cover each with a recording of what its run delivered (owner decision 2026-10-11 17:07: 「用我的账号重做 8 个首页案例，所有的案例可以使用opus5.5来去使用」). Each canvas is arranged for one Claude Opus 5.5 call per node with at most 32,000 output tokens, its own thinking included: a 2D build writes its page (16,000 characters); a 3D case has an upstream node deliver the three.js scene as code for the build to paste and wire (24,000); the port cockpit and the glider, whose single scene module still ran out of tokens, split it into two 7,000-character modules (28,000). All eight ran on the live AwwO in the operator's own account on 2026-10-11, and each record says what was checked in a browser before publishing and what was not (the port's crane clicks land on a ship); `scripts/showcase/publish-run.mjs` takes the edition, model label, limits, thinking and revisions from the run's notes. Every cover is now a 6-second recording of the delivered page played by a script and labelled 交付录屏, captioned in the case dialog with the run's date; the AI-generated covers are removed. The homepage result frame gives delivered pages AwwO's pinned three.js, as the 成果 preview does, and the HTML output policy names that one supplied tag (three.js r128) instead of forbidding every library. A collapsed card's overview skips a code delivery's fence and bracket-only lines.
- Answer a managed-execution (直接执行) task's question at once with "go on with sensible defaults and say what you assumed", instead of after 2 minutes: the owner's choice of 2026-10-11 (「提问也不等，直接按默认继续」) is that a task never waits on a question. The answer goes along the owner's own response path and is audited as `computer.response.auto_answer` with no actor, as before. `AWWO_COMPUTER_QUESTION_WAIT_SECONDS` (0 to 900; unset is 0) gives a deployment that wants owners to answer that many seconds first; anything else is refused at startup.
- Say what the free allowance includes now that Claude, GPT and Bedrock are open to free workspaces (since 2026-10-11, within each workspace's daily calls and under the service-wide daily ceilings of `AWWO_ROUTE_TOTAL_PER_DAY`): the premium refusal, the direct-execution note, the allowance popover, the assistant's next-step lead, the daily-limit upsell, the plans page and Plans and credits no longer say that the free plan includes the default model only or that Claude and GPT need Pro. A model is still marked as needing Pro or Max where a workspace's allowance closes its route (a limit of 0), and the plans still offer credits for these models outside the shared free calls.
- Show the image, video and 3D generators AwwO runs as its own media models, never by the service behind them (owner decision 2026-10-11: 「不要展示出来是什么，就写成媒体节点就好了」): their models' group in the node settings and on node cards is 「媒体 / Media」 (the node card used to show the raw vendor slug), and the models named after their provider are 「Image 3.0」, 「Image 3.0 Pro」, 「Video V3」, 「3D v3.1 · 高精度模型」 and 「3D P1 · 游戏低多边形」 (ids, prices and parameters unchanged; a test keeps provider names out of them). A media node still set to a model of the retired generator (`rh.*`, no longer run in production) moves, when its canvas opens and the workspace is not offered that model, to the model of the same family it is offered (Seedream, Nano Banana, GPT Image) or else to its kind's first, with that model's default settings; its earlier results stay, its next Send sets it up again, and nothing announces the move.
- Name every image, video and 3D model by a generic name in the reader's language, never by its model family, maker or version (owner decision 2026-10-11: 「模型名也全部改成通用名」), all of them in the one 「媒体 / Media」 group: images 「图片 · 高清」 (2K by default), 「图片 · 超清」 (up to 4K), 「图片 · 超清多张」 and 「图片 · 超清多张 Pro」 (up to 4 a run, up to 4K), 「图片 · 标准多张」 and 「图片 · 标准多张 Pro」 (up to 6 a run), 「图片 · 全能」; videos 「视频 · 标准」, 「视频 · 全能」, 「视频 · 全能 Pro」; 3D 「3D · 高精度」 and 「3D · 游戏低多边形」, each with its English name (Image · HD, Video · Standard, 3D · High detail …). The media catalogue (`GET /tenants/{id}/media`) now sends each model's `label` (`[Chinese, English]`, its `name` the Chinese one for older pages) under the single vendor `media`, and no longer says which provider runs a model (the `provider` fields are gone); ids, prices, parameters and stored nodes are unchanged. Tests keep provider, model-family and maker names and version numbers out of every name a user sees.
- A component running on its own shows its progress on its card; the run timeline opens by itself only for a run of several steps, and never in simple mode, so it no longer covers the board other components keep working on.
- Run a delivered page as soon as it is shown, as the homepage cases' results already do (owner decision 2026-10-11: 「不要有运行交互这个按钮，成果可以直接进行交互」). The 成果 view, node deliverables, graph outputs and execution previews no longer show a static copy behind 运行交互/停止交互; the page runs at once in the same sandbox as before (opaque origin, no AwwO account or storage access, inline scripts only, `connect-src 'none'`), with 重新开始, 全屏 and 源码, and the hint 「点一下画面，再用键盘操作。」. Every homepage case renders to the very document the homepage frame shows. Because no sandbox flag can stop a page from sending its own frame to another address, a second load of the frame puts the delivered page back with a note, and a page that does so three times within 15 seconds is stopped and shown as source. While the expanded copy is open the inline copy stays static, so a page never runs twice at once. In the 成果 view a page gets the height the homepage gives a focused result (`min(820px, 78dvh)`), so a game laid out for a browser window fits on a 1080p screen. Gallery thumbnails stay static.

- Stop the canvas assistant's changes from using up the free daily calls (owner decision 2026-10-10: newcomers spent their 30 calls asking the assistant before ever running a canvas). A plan the assistant requests on the operator's planner model (`AWWO_PLANNER_MODEL`) is no longer counted towards, or held by, a free workspace's daily runs or a plan's default-model calls; concurrency still applies. Its own per-workspace ceiling bounds it instead, now 20 a day by default (`AWWO_PLANNER_PER_WORKSPACE_PER_DAY`, was 30). Past it the plan falls back to the default model as before, which is an ordinary call and counts; a workspace whose calls are used up can still have its canvas arranged within the 20. `GET /tenants/{id}/route-usage` reports `planner {limit, used}`, the header meter shows it as its own row, and the assistant's composer says how many free changes are left today.
- Tag the models a workspace's plan does not include. `GET /tenants/{id}/runtime` and `GET /tenants/{id}/computer-runtime` give each model its `route` (`free`, `gate`, `bedrock`) and `requiresUpgrade: true` when the workspace is on the free plan with that route closed (0); a plan or a workspace without route limits never sees it. Every model picker (node settings, team members, the model shelf, official copies, direct tasks) shows such a model as 「… · Pro」, the node title a dropped model gets stays untagged, and choosing one for a direct task says that it needs Pro / Max next to the upgrade button before the task is sent.
- Make the canvas assistant one conversation. There is no 「编排画布 / 直接执行」 switch any more: each message goes to the server first (`POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/canvases/{id}/assistant/route`), which decides whether it arranges the canvas or becomes a task in the workspace. A message that edits the canvas in so many words, with no negation in it, is planned at once; every other message is read by the planner's own free model, with its thinking off and a 24-token answer, and whatever the router cannot tell is planned, since a plan is undone in one step while a task makes up to 16 calls. The router's call is the platform's and not counted against the workspace's allowance, and it is bounded: one call in flight in all and per user, 20 a minute and 300 a day per user, a clipped prompt, and only on a worker that lists the per-call options and keeps a slot free for planning. Each reply says how it was handled (「调整画布」 / 「直接执行」), and the latest request can be handed over to the other way: a plan still on the canvas is undone once its task exists, and a task still running is stopped first; a hand-over that fails changes nothing but says why. A message joins the conversation once it is handled, so a stop, a refusal (a node still running, say) or leaving the page leaves it in the box rather than unanswered. While the canvas cannot be arranged, messages become tasks and the composer says so; a task start whose outcome is unknown is recorded as unconfirmed and reconciled, never planned over or sent again. The model for direct tasks is chosen in a row under the composer, earlier tasks are folded at the top of the conversation, a read-only canvas shows its tasks, and the desktop app, which has no task host, still only plans.
- Copy the knowledge-base case too. Its canvas is the one that ran on 2026-09-04 in AwwO's local development preview, recovered from the run itself: every agent's persona as it loaded it, and every node's task, field descriptions and wires as in the message it received, which a test composes again and checks against the run's evidence (the SHA-256 of six messages; the first node had no wired input and is checked by length). Input IDs, required flags and placeholders, which the messages do not carry, come from that day's agent templates; the IDs of three inputs the canvas planner added were never kept and are assigned. The copy keeps the canvas in Chinese, as it ran, with each agent's recorded fields as its 「案例实录」, and the copy dialog says where it ran and what stayed on that computer. The case dialog now shows each node's persona, template role and hand-off and names every wire after the input field it fills, and its run receipt no longer calls that environment AwwO desktop.
- Copy a production case with its run, not just its canvas. Every node of the copy carries what its agent delivered in the case's recorded run, labelled 「案例实录」 with the model and the date, and every node's inputs show what it received upstream, so a member can see how each part was made. Running the whole graph replaces the recordings with the member's own results, and rerunning one node reuses its upstream recordings. Choosing models, rewording tasks or rewiring keeps the recordings for reference; a node's own new result clears the recordings that stood on it. The copy dialog says all this beforehand, and tells an English-speaking member that the agents worked in Chinese. A case whose recording cannot be loaded is not copied at all, rather than copied empty.
- Merge the execution assistant into the canvas assistant: one 「画布助手」 that also does tasks (how each message is routed is in the entry above). A task reads as a conversation: your message, then the assistant's card with one live status line (elapsed time and real counts, no invented progress), the permissions and questions it needs answered inline (allowed once or denied only by your click), the result, and its files with preview, download and save-to-knowledge; the process stays folded. Model and reasoning effort are dropdowns from the server's catalogue in one quiet line (effort only for models that offer it, reset when the model changes; a model the catalogue drops stays selected and is marked unavailable), with 管理我的引擎 and a list refresh beside them. An unavailable service is explained once, with the fix. Viewers can read the task history. Requests stay bounded, running tasks are polled, and an unknown outcome is reconciled with its original identity, never resent. The separate 执行助手 button and window are gone.
- Bring the knowledge workbench, the execution assistant, the account dialog and the platform admin pages onto the hosted app's design: the account's colour scheme and the dark theme now reach them, actions are ink pills, links and focus are teal, small 9–11px text is legible, the knowledge kinds keep fixed source/page/decision colours, the account dialog follows the main site's account page (white panels on salt paper, sentence-case labels, read-only values shown as text), and the admin page sets its back link beside the logo, its figures in one ruled row and its tables scrolling sideways on phones.
- Keep the canvas readable with real run data: while a node is open the execution timeline steps aside like the minimap (its toggle and palette command wait, with the reason) and returns when the node closes; beside an open minimap the timeline stops short of it; timeline rows size their columns to names and engines; a closed card keeps its whole state label (「上游节点未完成」 no longer clips to 「上游」) and hides it only when zoomed out past legibility; a long delivery fades at the drawer's bottom edge while more is below; and canvas names on the home take two lines.
- Open a canvas node where its card sits instead of moving it to the centre: the camera keeps the card's corner in place at a readable zoom, moves only as far as the stage needs and glides there and back. Every way of leaving the node (closing it, Escape, deleting it, undoing its addition, closing a delivery opened from the run summary) returns to the view you had, which is also the view that is saved. A node opened for configuration keeps clear of the inspector while staying readable, and the minimap steps aside while a node is open.
- Answer canvas actions visibly: menus, dialogs and panels open with short motion, buttons and cards dip when pressed, a card that finishes or fails while you watch rings once (statuses restored when a canvas loads do not), a node's menu closes when you press elsewhere or the card changes layout, long agent names take two lines on closed cards, and creating a canvas shows your request with one progress card. Motion follows the system's reduced-motion setting.
- Restyle the hosted app on the ClawHunt main site's AwwO design: the Tide Pool palette (salt paper, abyss ink, teal for links, focus and live work) with a Night dive dark theme, self-hosted Mona Sans for Latin text with condensed display titles, ink pill actions with the ClawHunt claw on the main calls to action, the AwwO orb on the sign-in page, the workspace home and the canvas assistant, and the canvas framed by rounded panels. A node's deliverables open in the main site's dark workspace panel, each delivered file on a white sheet. Account colour schemes still override every colour, text meets WCAG AA in both themes, and Chinese headings keep natural spacing and, on wide screens, break only at spaces and punctuation.
- Offer 19 more Bedrock models in the built-in catalog (42 of 50): Claude Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1, Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Fable 5, Opus 4.8, Sonnet 4.6 and Haiku 4.5, Grok 4.7 and 4.6, Kimi K3, DeepSeek R1, Pixtral Large, Llama 4 Maverick and Scout, Llama 3.3 70B, and Nova 2 Lite, Pro and Micro. Each was verified through the workers with the production instance role, on cross-region inference profiles. Pixtral Large and the Llama models move to Pi as plain chat models, because Bedrock does not stream tool calls for them. Claude Sonnet 5.5 and the seven GPT models stay off until AWS Marketplace accepts the account's subscription (it refused it with `INVALID_PAYMENT_INSTRUMENT`).
- Replace the one-card automatic introduction with the work-mode tutorial; the step-by-step page tour stays available on request.
- Retire the three playable mock-ups made outside AwwO from the production cases; the cards now label their cover footage 「封面示意 · AI 生成」 apart from the knowledge base's recording, and claim delivery only where a published run delivered.
- Keep the home page focused on starting work: offer editable prompt starters next to the composer and three interactive examples before expanding the complete library. Keep model search visible and model rows compact, preserving every runtime and capability label.
- Support bounded catalogs of up to 256 models per runtime or personal connection, rejecting overflow instead of silently hiding models. Existing workspace model permissions remain unchanged.
- Keep workspace navigation focused on the active workspace and account; move language, theme, guidance and maintenance actions into an accessible overflow menu.
- Show one short automatic introduction per account and device, with detailed guidance available on demand. Preserve the model library on the left and Bot list on the right.
- Put provider and API key first during engine setup, group runtime/name options under advanced settings, and offer a direct return after verified model availability.
- Make node inputs start with task values; reveal editable field structure only when requested. Move canvas rename/delete into per-card menus and hide pagination on single-page lists.

### Fixed

- Keep every picture and clip the operator's Jimeng account makes, and edit its own pictures in place (owner request 2026-10-12: 准备修复版本，修好后重跑极光 GT 并补齐两张图). A result whose download Jimeng answers with a passing failure (it said busy while several results of one canvas run came back at once, so two pictures that were made and paid for were lost) is fetched again, up to four times. An image-to-image run from a picture Jimeng generated for the workspace names that picture's own resource on Jimeng's canvas instead of uploading it again (the upload of 极光 GT's white car was refused on the host, so its red and blue versions were never made); any doubt still uploads it. Every failed CLI call is logged by its structured fields only (command, exit code, the CLI's code, class and request id, never its message or arguments), so a failure on the host can be told apart.
- Keep `hidden` and `readonly` in delivered-page previews (`htmlDeliverable.ts`). The preview sanitizer dropped both, so a page's closed dialog was open on load (FRAME's export dialog covered its whole page) and its fixed fields became editable, in 成果 and on the homepage alike.
- Keep a page's one automatic repair when the service refuses it before anything runs: the canvas recorded the request before sending it, so a repair refused for the workspace's run allowance (today's calls used up, every run slot busy) counted as done, and that delivery was never repaired, even after the calls came back. The free model's pages rely on this repair. A repair refused before it ran (`refusedCode` on the executor's result, from the service's admission refusal) now marks its record with a time from which the same delivery goes back: half an hour on for `quota_exceeded` and `plan_busy`, the next UTC midnight for a daily allowance (`premium_quota_exceeded`, `premium_capacity_exceeded`, `free_capacity_exceeded`, `credits_exhausted`); any other refusal still counts as asked, and a later delivery is new (`pageRepair.ts`, `runTransport.ts`, `CanvasSurface.tsx`).
- Run a page that a canvas run hands a 3D model (found 2026-10-12 in the first official-example runs with wired media). A 3D node's result is typed `file`, so its wire into a page keeps `dataType: "file"`, and the stored-file reader (`readGraphInputFiles`, used for text and workspace runtimes alike) took the model's `awwo.media` record for one stored file: every such page failed with `workspace_input_not_stored` before it ran, and the nodes after it were blocked. A media node's wire is now left to the file list `graphPrompt` writes (`mediaDeliveryText`, or `mediaMissingText` when no model was made), exactly as a picture's or a clip's. Verified: `TestGraphFileInputsLeaveA3DResultToItsFileList` and `TestPostgresGraphRunPageTakesA3DModel` (both fail without the fix, the PostgreSQL one with exactly `workspace_input_not_stored`), plus the graph, workspace and media PostgreSQL tests.
- Show a wired picture in its page wherever the page is opened. The node's deliverables drawer and the 成果 view's step page (`ArtifactPreview`) loaded images only as `data:` URLs, so a page naming a picture another node made (`<node id>/image-1.png`, as a canvas run hands it over) showed a broken image there; such a page now runs in the studio's live page with the canvas's files put in place, as the card preview and the studio already did, keeping the drawer's restart, full screen, source, enlarge and download. A page that names no relative file, or a preview with no canvas around it, is unchanged. A media node's result-port guide no longer says a text node's context takes text only: it says a page or text node takes the files' paths through its context or a text field.
- Keep a page when a picture wired into it was not made. A media node's result feeding a text input (the canvas assistant now wires a generated picture, clip or 3D model into the page that shows it) is a soft dependency, in the API's scheduler (`softMediaEdge`) and the web's runner and node chat alike (`isSoftMediaFeed`): when the generation fails, is refused (a new workspace has one media generation a day, so a planned canvas with several wired pictures always meets refusals), is cancelled or never ran, the page still runs and its input reads 「…」这次没有生成出图片文件… instead of the file list, and only the media node fails. A picture wired into another picture's reference input still holds that generation back. Verified with a Postgres run (the day's allowance refuses the picture on the second run; the page is made, told no file exists, and one generation was paid for) and web cases for the runner, the node chat and the note.
- Repair an explainer figure whose own script fails inside the figure kit too: `Anatomy.run` catches that error, logs it and shows its "Figure script error · 图解脚本出错" card instead of throwing, so the page error reporter saw nothing and nothing was repaired. The first explainer figure run on production (2026-10-12, qwen3.8-27b-p6, 1 min 40 s) stopped exactly so, at `Cannot access … before initialization`. The reporter now also reports the first such card, with the Error the kit logged just before it, whose stack names the page's lines; a page that only logs an Error and shows no card reports nothing. Verified in Chrome through the real preview (a figure failing inside `Anatomy.run` reports `ReferenceError: Cannot access 'crank' before initialization` with its two lines; a figure that runs reports nothing) and with a jsdom case.

- Make what an image, video or 3D node generates that node's delivery (owner request 2026-10-12: 「修好媒体节点结果进成果页并上线」): a live test on the owner's account that day (one 3D node, the 3D · 游戏低多边形 model, tanqunzhao's first hero prompt) generated and stored its model, which the node's chat showed with its preview, the rotating viewer and the GLB download, while the node's 交付物 said 「还没有交付物」 and the canvas's 成果 said 「还没有成果」. A reply typed in a node's chat becomes its delivery only when it is a structured follow-up delivery or a page repair, and a media node generates only from its chat because a canvas run leaves media nodes out, so no generated picture, video or model ever reached 交付物, 成果 or the nodes downstream. A media node's finished generation (the `awwo.media` record of its own kind, with every file stored) is now published as its delivery when the send ends, and on recovery after a reload; a failed or cancelled generation keeps the delivery before it, and other nodes' replies are unchanged.
- Rerun the homepage's 港口三维驾驶舱 case (port-twin) on Claude Opus 5.5 so that clicking a quay crane opens that crane's own card (owner request 2026-10-12: 「重跑港口案例修好岸桥点击」): the published run had opened ship S1's card for every crane, because its crane-and-ship code raycast the open gantry frames and a ray slipped between the girders to the ship behind. That node's task now prescribes the pick: each crane's and ship's overall `THREE.Box3` with `ray.intersectBox`, nearest first, and a `THREE.BoxHelper` highlight (two earlier reruns that asked for invisible pick proxies hit the 32,000-token output limit on that node). The new run (2026-10-12, 6/6 nodes in 20 min 15 s) was checked in Chrome before publishing: all four cranes, clicked mid-gantry and at the top, open QC-1 to QC-4, ships open their own cards, and the clock, 4×, pause, the space bar, departures and the metrics work; its verification text also says that ships overlap near the anchorage and berths once many wait. The cover is a new recording of that page in a 1280×720 window, clicking QC-2 and QC-3.
- Stop a delivered page from staying blank in a running preview when it sizes itself from the window at startup: on 2026-10-12 the homepage's 像素平台跳跃 case came up as an empty dark panel in 3 of 5 opens on the live site (7 of 8 against a local copy of that build). A sandboxed preview frame can start the page before it learns its own size, so the page reads a 0×0 window, and the browser does not always send `resize` once the real size arrives (Chrome may take it as the starting size; WebKit sends none while a document loads). Running previews (the homepage cases, a node's delivered page, the 成果 studio and a page opened in its own tab) now run one script of AwwO's own ahead of the page: only for a frame that started at 0×0, once the document has loaded into a real size, it sends the page one `resize` event, and it stops looking after 15 s. A page that started with a real size sees no change; the delivered bytes, their checksum and the CSP are unchanged. Against the same local build the case then rendered in 12 of 12 opens and played (click, Enter, run, jump).
- Let the canvas assistant deal with a canvas whose run failed (a user's report forwarded on 2026-10-11: 「画布助手只能看到input文件夹，我说画布的最后一个节点运行失败了让他修复他理解不了，成果页面说交付物在output文件夹画布助手也看不见」; three messages had gone to direct tasks, whose workspace held an empty `inputs/` and nothing of the canvas). (1) A short message about the last run's failure (「画布的最后一个节点运行失败了」「处理失败」「节点报错了，帮我修一下」, "the last node failed, fix it") is answered by the canvas, which ran the nodes, before any routing: the reply names the failed node and why, and unless the message only asks why, the failed nodes and everything they feed run again, as 「重新运行失败的节点」 does; a quota or premium refusal gets the advice instead, since running again would be refused the same way; a message that asks for a change, says nothing failed, or is about failure in general (「写一份项目失败原因的分析报告」) goes to the assistant as before. (2) A direct task (直接执行) reads, after the user's words, a read-only account of the canvas it was started from: each component with the latest canvas run's state and failure reason, an excerpt of what it delivered, and its delivered files, with small text files (20 KB in all) inline when the request is about deliverables. It is told that components' files are not in its workspace, that a path a component mentions (such as `/workspace/output/index.html`) exists nowhere the user can open, and that the canvas assistant runs failed components again when asked; the task's transcript shows the user's words alone. (3) A delivery whose JSON has a slip with one reading is read instead of refused as "Output must be a JSON object keyed by output field IDs": the last string value missing only its closing quote before exactly the brackets that were open (the reporter's game page, twice), raw control characters inside strings, a backslash that starts no JSON escape (`\'`, `\d`, `\u{…}` in embedded code), and an ASCII double quote that cannot end its string (the planner's rule); a run stopped by its output cap is failed by its runtime and never reaches the repair, and the contract is checked on what the repair read. Of the 15 deliveries refused that way in the 14 days to 2026-10-12, all from the default model, 10 are read and satisfy their contracts (counted on production, read-only, with a Python port checked byte for byte against the Go code on 3,060 vectors). A run detail with such a refusal now says what it means, in the reader's language. (4) A node whose contract has no file or HTML field is told that only its fields reach the reader and never to point at a file path or folder as where a result is. (5) A delivery published by hand after a failed run (source `manual`, shown as 手动采用) is that node's result: the canvas no longer calls the node failed or offers to run it again, which would replace it.

- Stop a canvas run (运行整张画布) or a component run from failing whole on a canvas that holds an image, video or 3D node: the page submitted every node, and the API refuses a graph run that names a media node (`media_graph_unsupported`, "图像与视频节点需单独运行"), so after tanqunzhao's canvas received five 3D nodes on 2026-10-11 its whole-canvas run could no longer start. A run now leaves media nodes out and hands on what they made before, as it does for any upstream outside its scope (a node that needs a media node's result still waits for that result), and a whole-canvas run still runs alone; asking to run media nodes only says 「媒体节点不随画布运行，请在节点上点「发送」生成。」. A media node's own Send is unchanged, and the API still refuses a graph run that names one.
- Stop managed execution (直接执行) from failing for the service's own reasons, as 24 free-plan runs of 2026-10-09/11 did. (1) Every model call of a task that took longer than 30 s was cut off at exactly 30 s, the API's ordinary request deadline, and the task failed as `computer_execution_failed` (`computer_model_transport` in the worker's log); qwen's thinking often needs longer. The internal model proxy (`POST /api/internal/computer-model/v1/chat/completions`) is no longer under that deadline: a call is bounded by its own 10 minutes (the workers' own limit) and its task. (2) A worker with every slot taken refused new tasks at once (`computer_busy`, 11 runs): a task now waits in line, asking again every 3 s for up to 10 minutes (never more than half of what is left of its run), its card says 「执行环境都在忙，已排队，空出来就开始」 (`waitingForSlot` in the task's detail, from `computer_queued` / `computer_started` run events), and only a wait past that ends it as `computer_busy`. Production's `AWWO_OPENMAUS_MAX_CONCURRENT` was raised from 2 to 6 the same day. (3) Tasks waited for their owner to allow a tool of their own isolated workspace (every task began by asking to list its empty workspace) or to answer a question, and held a slot until the worker's 15-minute limit (`TIMEOUT`, 5 runs), which kept the slots full: the workspace tools named by `AWWO_COMPUTER_AUTO_ALLOW_TOOLS` (unset: all six `awwo_workspace_*` tools, which act only inside the task's sandbox; `none` asks for every one; nothing else can be named) are allowed as they are requested, a question left unanswered for 2 minutes is answered "go on with sensible defaults and say what you assumed", both along the owner's own response path and audited as `computer.response.auto_allow` / `computer.response.auto_answer` with no actor, and the task is told not to ask avoidable questions.
- Stop canvas plans from failing whole as `invalid_canvas_plan` for slips with one safe reading (all eight such plans of 2026-10-09/10, replayed, now apply): ASCII double quotes a model used as quotation marks inside Chinese text (点击"新建"; six of the eight, Haiku and Qwen alike) are escaped, and so are raw line breaks inside strings, when the answer is not JSON as written (a repair that still is not one JSON value changes nothing, and every answer the gate refused before for any other reason is still refused); a new field whose `value` is missing becomes empty, a new input field that came filled is added empty and then filled by a `set_input`, and a filled new output field loses its value; a new node ref or field id the canvas refuses (`prototype`, `constructor`, `__proto__`) is renamed with every reference to it. The gate also takes the operations the canvas's planning protocol offers and its parser applies, which it refused until now: `connect` with `kind` (`data` or `feedback`), `set_edge_kind` and `set_execution` (workflow, or review with 1–5 rounds); the planner's instructions list them, and the gate's operations are pinned to the canvas's by a test.

- Let a delivered game that loads three.js r128 from a CDN run inside the 成果/deliverable preview (the 2026-10-10 3D hero game showed a dead page: the preview drops every external script, so `THREE` was undefined). When a running page names one of the exact r128 URLs (cdnjs, jsDelivr, unpkg), the preview inlines AwwO's own copy of that release: npm `three@0.128.0` `build/three.min.js` through the exactly pinned alias `three-r128`, byte for byte the file cdnjs serves (603,445 bytes, sha256 `9274bbce…`), loaded as a separate chunk only when a page needs it; its size is checked before use and its hash by the tests. The preview's CSP is unchanged (inline scripts only, `connect-src 'none'`), so no host is allowed. A page that also calls `THREE.CapsuleGeometry` (added in r139; the game built every character from it and stopped at the first) gets three.js's own r139 implementation, defined only when missing. Running previews also allow pointer lock, which a first-person game needs for mouse look (Esc releases it), and offer 全屏 for a game laid out for a whole window, whose menu does not fit the inline frame. The note under a running page says which library AwwO supplied and names the hosts of any other external script it did not load.
- Keep a delivery whose JSON lost only its final closing brackets (the 2026-10-10 3D game: a complete `index.html` in a file field, then no closing `}`). The server and the canvas now read every node delivery through one normalization that restores closers missing at the very end, and only then: text that ends inside a string, after a separator, key, number or literal, that closes early or would need more than eight closers is unchanged and still fails, so a delivery cut off mid-content is never passed off as complete. Validation, file storage, transcript projection, the deliverables view and card previews read the same object, so such a node now settles as done, its file is stored and downloadable, and downstream nodes receive it.
- Say what to do when a review does not pass. A run whose nodes all succeeded while its acceptance node concluded 「不通过」 used to end with 「运行完成：7/7 节点成功」 and a 「接下来」 that only offered the results, and asking the assistant 「验收不通过，我该怎么办」 got a counted call that could not see the report and asked the user to describe it (2026-10-10, a real canvas). A review node's latest delivery is now read for its verdict (`reviewVerdict`: the 「结论：」 line of a review template or a review-titled node, or a yes/no approval field; 不通过、需修复、有条件通过、证据不足、Fail and the like), and the assistant's next steps lead with it: 「「X」的结论是「不通过」：<its reason>」, the closed assistant is marked, the run summary adds the verdict with 「看下一步」, and the steps are 「按验收意见返工「<the reviewed Agent>」（至少 N 次）」 and 「查看验收报告」. Rework, on a hosted canvas, writes the review's report and issue list into the reviewed Agent's task requirements (one constraint, bounded to the requirement limits and replaced by the next rework from the same review, visible and editable in the node's settings), then runs that Agent and everything it feeds again, the review included. Short questions about the outcome (「验收没通过怎么办」「运行失败了怎么处理」, `isOutcomeQuestion`) are answered from the canvas at no cost while it has such an outcome. A passing review is named when every node has a result.

- Stop a canvas assistant plan from failing whole on one connection the model wrote imperfectly (`画布方案：无法连接：字段不存在、类型不匹配、输入已占用或连线重复。`): a second source for an occupied input, a delivery of another type, or an input the node lacks now gives the target an input of its own for that delivery; fields are found by id, prefixed id, case or label; a link a field change breaks is disconnected; a field added again takes the plan's definition; an input value that does not fit and a connection that would loop are left out. The same connection sent again (a planner often re-sends the existing wiring) changes nothing instead of adding another copy of the repaired input; a connection to a node the plan creates further on is made after it, and one to a node that is not there is skipped; a wire whose field was deleted or retyped by hand (hidden on the board, so it could not be disconnected, and every later plan failed on it) is dropped, and editing a node's fields no longer leaves such wires behind; in a cloud workspace a connect marked `"kind":"data"` (the default) is applied instead of refusing the plan; image, video and 3D nodes keep their fixed ports when a plan edits fields. Each adjustment is listed with the plan's summary in the reply, and a plan whose every step was skipped says nothing changed instead of showing as applied.
- Keep the 成果 view readable on a stage narrowed by the assistant panel and the Bots list: its layout follows its own width, the result no longer slides under "How it was made", file tabs wrap, and the board's floating "Run complete" note no longer covers it.
- Say where a node's files are: delivered files and pages are named above the deliverable tabs, with file icons on the tabs; in a cloud workspace a file field that holds only a name ("index.html") says no file was handed over and offers to run again. The file-output policy now tells agents that a path-like label still means the file object, and that a web page or browser game ships as a complete `index.html`.
- Shorten the notice under each composer to one line (「AI 内容仅供参考 · 勿输入敏感信息」); the full notice stays its tooltip and accessible description.

- Tell a newcomer everything the canvas still needs, without spending their calls. The assistant's 「接下来 / Next」 now lists every node whose required inputs nothing feeds, one row each with its own 「去填写 / Fill in」 (it named only the first, so the rest were found one refused run at a time), says what a run then costs (「运行整张画布（至少 N 次）」: one call per Agent and per team member, more with tools), and on a canvas of three or more Agents offers trying the first node alone. Asking 「现在缺什么」「下一步做什么」 or the like (a deliberately narrow match on the whole message, `isNextStepsQuestion`) is answered from the canvas instead of being routed: it was a counted call, and up to 16 when routed to a direct task, so free users spent their daily allowance asking how to start. Under the hosted composer a line says what a message costs (about 1 call to change the canvas, up to 16 for a direct task) and which questions cost none. A workspace whose run allowance is full (`quota_exceeded`, today's calls or runs at once) is now offered the Pro and Max plans first, on nodes, in run details (which showed the bare code), on direct tasks and in the assistant's next steps; the copy no longer sends free users to an administrator.

- Let a canvas that has run as a whole graph be deleted. 「确认删除」 answered "Could not complete the request" for every canvas with a finished graph run, from the canvas list and from 「最近的成果」 alike: its graph-run nodes and collaboration turns point at the canvas's conversations and runs through foreign keys without a delete action, and PostgreSQL checked them while the one delete still held those rows (`graph_run_nodes_tenant_id_session_id_fkey`, 23503). The delete now removes the canvas's finished graph runs first, in the same transaction, so their nodes and turns go with them; an active run still refuses the delete and keeps everything. No migration.

- Let the canvas assistant say what to do next without being asked. Above its composer it now names the situation and offers one-click steps worked out from the canvas and its latest run: a free premium refusal leads with 「升级 Pro / Max」, then 「换成默认模型（免费）」 (the node's settings) and a rerun; any other failure opens the failed node and offers the rerun; a required input nothing feeds opens that node's settings; a canvas that never ran offers 「运行整张画布」, a partly delivered one the nodes left, and a finished one its results. Nothing is offered while a run or a message is handled. A problem (a failure, a missing input) also marks the closed 「画布助手」 toggle with a dot. A direct task refused by the free premium allowance offers the paid plans and 「改用默认模型」 for direct tasks, without sending anything again, and the refusal now says the free plan's daily calls are for the default model only, so it no longer reads as contradicting 「今日额度 · 剩 N 次」.

- Let a node's model reach its collaboration team. Enabling 「启用多 Agent 协作」 copied the node's model into the first member as that member's own choice, so switching the node to another model afterwards (the default model, as a premium-quota failure advises) left every run calling the old one and failing the same way. A new team's members now inherit the node's model; switching the node's model in its settings carries the change to members that held the previous node model; and the settings name any team member whose own model the node's model does not reach (「Agent 1 · 名称 · 模型」) with 「改为跟随节点模型 / Make them follow the node model」 to point them back. A run that fails on the free premium allowance (`premium_quota_exceeded`, `premium_capacity_exceeded`) now leads with the paid way forward: its run details offer 「升级 Pro / Max，继续使用高级模型」, which opens Plans and credits in a new tab and records the upgrade interest the usage meter records, and the message names team members' own models in the free way forward. The 「今日免费额度」 popover of a free workspace now says when the free plan includes no Claude, GPT or Bedrock call and makes 「升级 Pro / Max」 its first action (recording the same interest); 「想要更多次数」 stays as the second, and its confirmation no longer says paid plans are yet to launch.

- Publish successful, complete structured follow-up replies to the canvas delivery, readable conversation and downloads; keep the previous delivery for failed, cancelled or ordinary chat replies, and preserve revisions through cloud save and refresh recovery.
- Select an explicitly finalized downstream delivery as the canvas result, including a final author using review guidance, while keeping dedicated acceptance checks separate.
- Start the real sign-in flow from official-example reuse and preserve the selected example and bounded Orbit preview controls across navigation. Public example links remain shareable gallery links.
- Carry the user's exact original request into every newly planned Pi or Jev role, and keep exact quantities, budget limits and explicit later revisions distinct during execution and review.

- Accept a canvas plan that the model follows with a note. Claude Haiku 4.5 answers with a ```json block and then a sentence after its closing fence, which the plan gate read as part of the JSON, so every such plan failed as `invalid_canvas_plan`. The block now ends at its closing fence (found after the JSON value, so a fence inside a string cannot end it) and the note is dropped; text between the plan and the fence, a second value, an unfenced plan with a note and a preamble are still refused.
- Accept html fields in canvas plans. The planner is told it may add html fields (a page deliverable), but the server's plan gate refused the type, so any such plan failed as `invalid_canvas_plan`. The gate's field types are now pinned to the canvas's own list.
- Say why a task ended without its result: computer_busy (the workspace runs one task at a time), computer_unavailable, computer_rejected and the other task errors read as a sentence instead of a code.
- Keep the camera where it is on undo and redo. Each undo step is a copy of the canvas as it was, and restoring one also put back the camera saved at that moment, while the screen stayed where it was: the canvas saved a camera you could not see and reopened on it. The camera is not part of the history, so an undo or a redo now keeps the camera the canvas has.
- Stop saving the camera the app fits on its own. Opening a canvas on a screen where its saved camera does not show the whole graph refits the view, and so does a window resize, a side rail toggling or the assistant opening. Each of those fits was saved as if it were where you left the canvas, which overwrote your camera and moved the canvas up the recently updated lists, 「最近的成果」 included. Only a camera you move is saved now: a pan or zoom (past a click's few pixels of wobble), a recalled waypoint, Fit All, or the fit of an arrangement or plan you asked for. The app's own default camera on a canvas with none saved is not saved either.
- Stop recovering a canvas's last run again every time it opens. The server reports a blocked or waiting step with an empty output, which counted as a result the canvas lacked, so a canvas whose last run had a blocked step rebuilt that run on each open: it showed 「已从后台恢复运行结果」 every time, and the first open in another browser re-stamped the results' time with the server's clock and saved the canvas. Only a result the recovery would publish counts now. Applying a run again keeps a delivery the canvas already shows as it is, and no longer clears what was published downstream of it since.
- Keep a link without a scheme (such as `artifacts/report.md`, a file where the agent worked) as text instead of opening a page that does not exist, in a node's deliveries, in a run's node results and in the execution assistant's output, and render the preview of an input field the way deliveries render: a wired value is another agent's delivery, so its links open in a new tab instead of leaving the canvas, and its images are not loaded.
- Keep an open node's conversation inside its box: with the input form open, the transcript was squeezed to a few pixels and a run's status line (「运行状态：失败」) was drawn over the message box.
- Keep the account panel's "Invite a member" section in order for ClawHunt-linked accounts: the heading, the role and the button share a row, and the ClawHunt note, the permission note, the invitation pager and the list take full rows. Before, the note took the role's cell and everything after it shifted one cell: a one-word-wide note, the create button squeezed to a dot under about 820 px, and the invitation list beside its pager.
- Keep the work-mode tutorial's pictures inside their column. On the second step ("One brief becomes a canvas") the one-line example brief widened the picture past its frame, so the brief and the case canvas covered the step's title and text in English, stuck out of the frame or covered the text in Chinese, and let the whole step scroll sideways on phones. The pictures without a column layout of their own now get one column that cannot grow past the frame, and a long word in a node's input or output box breaks inside it; checked in Chrome on all seven steps, in both languages and themes, at 14 window sizes from 320 to 1440 px wide, and again with a much wider font.
- Open every work-mode tutorial step at its top. On a phone, where the text scrolls below the picture, the next step opened scrolled down past its picture once the reader had scrolled at all: the browser kept the text in place while the picture above it changed.
- Complete Seedance 2.0 video generations: RunningHub answers them with the video and a second, file-less `text` result (the token count), which the API tried to download, so every paid Seedance 2.0 generation failed with `media_result_refused`. Only results with a URL that are not `text` values are stored now; a task without any file still settles as `media_no_output`. All 18 RunningHub catalog models were then generated once with the production key (2026-10-05) and carry that date in `verified`.
- Keep failure text readable and whole: the failed state chips, the timeline's failed state and error banners now meet WCAG AA on their pale red ground (they measured 4.46:1), and an open node's header keeps its state chip whole beside a long title, which gives way first with an ellipsis.
- Show the account dialog's close and refresh icons, which the page's button padding had squeezed to a dot; keep its selects full width and in the text colour (header rules capped them at 170px, 100px on phones); line up the admin table's row rules (its action cell was not a table cell); and stop the knowledge search field drawing a second border inside the first.
- Keep a just-linked session when the page's first session check answers late: a reply can now end only the session its request was sent under, so the signed-out lookup made before an account link no longer marks the new session ended and stops the page's updates.
- Recover local draft writes from storage pressure by reclaiming only the current canvas's optional sync-proof cache. Acknowledge confirmed saves before replacing that cache, surface failed working-cache writes, and export the latest in-memory edits without removing other drafts or run history.
- Retry an unavailable execution-engine status without reloading the canvas, losing input, or starting work automatically.
- Show failed-node reasons in the execution timeline and open the relevant node directly. Completed runs link to their actual terminal deliveries, with a choice when several outputs are available.
- Announce the latest planning failure once, clarify quota recovery, and translate expired account sessions while preserving retry behavior.
- Preserve canvas-list search and expansion for each account and workspace when returning from a canvas; expose pagination during a search and clearly identify its current-page scope.
- Preserve confirmed model-run admission errors, including exhausted workspace quotas, without misreporting them as interrupted pages; uncertain or already accepted runs still recover by their original operation ID.
- Keep workspace dialogs scrollable within the viewport when long model catalogs or member lists exceed the screen height.
- Keep menu and run-history keyboard focus inside the open layer, prevent canvas shortcuts from acting behind it, and restore trigger focus on Escape.


## [0.9.0] - 2026-09-28

### Added

- Optional ClawHunt identity handoff with PKCE, approved-user checks, explicit proof before linking existing accounts, and session revocation. Existing workspaces, histories and personal connections retain their original user IDs. Configure and verify both services before enabling unified login.
- Jev planning inside the main API with an explicit workspace sponsorship switch, exact workspace allowlist, durable daily budget and live authorization checks. Personal model execution continues to use the user's credentials; sponsorship defaults to disabled.

### Fixed

- Preserve queued canvas edits while avoiding redundant saves. Keep task requirements and run evidence alongside role-specific Jev instructions.
- Verify LLM Gate credentials through an authenticated endpoint, filter transcription-only models from text execution, and accept plain text for single text deliveries.
- Improve model search and names, Bot labels, timeline placement, translated failure messages and full-screen artifact previews.
- Pass optional identity settings only to the API in Compose and allow the exact ClawHunt sign-in routes in the Mac client.

### Changed

- Consolidate verified product work on `main` as the only named branch. Preserve detached worktrees, private history and immutable release tags. Source publication and running-service deployment remain separate.
- Prepare Mac source version 0.9.0, build 7. The existing 0.8.1 build 6 release remains unchanged; this entry does not announce a new binary release.

## [0.8.1] - 2026-09-28

### Changed

- Replace the earlier W badge with the original AwwO Fold identity. Include editable SVG logos, custom wordmarks and transparent PNG icons in `assets/brand/awwo-fold`.
- Update the hosted web mark and favicon to Fold, and rebuild the Apple Silicon Mac client as version 0.8.1, build 6, with the same identity.
- Keep the Mac client's existing bundle identity and hosted account/workspace connection. The package includes no model credentials or local execution services. Native package release and hosted-site deployment remain separate operations.
- Package verified DMG, ZIP and Fold brand-kit downloads with SHA256 checksums from a clean source commit.

### Fixed

- Validate downloaded run-evidence content across Node and browser Blob realms instead of requiring the same constructor identity.

## [0.8.0] - 2026-09-27

### Added

- Human-authored task constraints and acceptance criteria on canvas nodes. Saved requirements are frozen into single, team, graph and collaboration executions and included in context admission budgets; older clients preserve them when saving.
- Read-only run evidence shows stored outputs, artifacts and checks against frozen delivery formats. Model claims and completed runs never count as human acceptance.
- Download a sanitized NDJSON projection of retained run events, including snapshot cursor, record count and SHA-256. Credentials split across text events are redacted; oversized downloads fail explicitly instead of returning a partial archive.

### Fixed

- Preserve binary preview-signing keys on Windows, including random newline bytes; isolate preview tests using the Windows home directory variable.

## [0.7.1] - 2026-09-20

### Added

- Lightweight Windows client sharing hosted accounts, workspaces and personal engine connections. The separate installation preserves the earlier local execution client and its data.
- Python OpenAI Agents workers accept authenticated, request-local personal credentials without shared-key fallback.

### Fixed

- Gemini connections omit the unsupported OpenAI `store` field in both Agents workers; real Gemini chat, conversation history and calculator execution are verified.
- Canvas regression checks wait for the actual request and canonical storage update, preventing timing-dependent false failures during release CI.
- Prevent browser password autofill from being forwarded as a provider API key; reject the account password on the server before making any provider request.
- Canvas planning uses the requesting user's available engine, including accounts with only an OpenAI Agents connection; personal selectors are never saved on the shared planner Agent.
- Personal credential mode blocks the legacy Jev service from spending operator credentials. Normal canvas planning remains available through the user's engine.

## [0.7.0] - 2026-09-20

### Added — personal accounts and execution credentials

- Login onboarding requires a verified personal provider connection. Users choose LLM Gate, OpenAI/Codex, Claude, Grok or Gemini and a supported engine, then supply their own API key. LLM Gate links to credential and credit purchase on its own site.
- Server-side AES-256-GCM vault, owner-scoped catalogs, and per-run worker configuration resolve credentials from the persisted run actor. Personal mode never falls back to shared operator credentials.
- Password changes, individual login-session revocation, and optional SMTP password recovery with single-use, expiring links. Password change/reset revokes all login sessions.
- One-command `npm run start:user` wrapper, production Compose defaults, additive migration 017, configuration and rollback guide in `docs/personal-accounts.md`.
- Bring the released iOS-inspired canvas, left model palette, right Bot/persona library, canvas return navigation, and hosted Mac shell source into the public source baseline.
- Add GitHub acceptance for PostgreSQL account regressions, worker isolation, SaaS web checks and production container builds; resolve the existing duplicate pnpm version configuration.

### Verification scope

Synthetic credentials/provider fixtures verify account isolation, background run admission, worker concurrency, secret handling and password/session behavior. Model catalog verification is not live paid-model inference or a hosted production rollout.

### Performance — reduce live-run latency and database amplification

- **What changed:** Wake each live run's SSE subscribers immediately after its queued, running, delta or terminal event commits, while retaining cursor-based PostgreSQL replay and a forced 15-second authorization heartbeat as a durable fallback. Persist a single-Agent delta and its replay event in one atomic SQL statement, and send only the new team-turn fragment from Go to PostgreSQL instead of rebinding the full accumulated output on every fragment.
- **Why:** Fixed 150ms polling issued event and status queries for every idle stream and delayed visible output. Four database round trips per single-Agent delta and repeatedly transferring the full team output amplified latency and connection pressure as responses and concurrency grew.
- **Impact:** Live committed output is delivered without polling delay. An idle stream's event/status reloads fall from about 13.3 to 0.13 queries per second; including the mandatory session/membership revalidation, its total steady database rate is about 0.2 queries per second. Durable reconnect, tenant isolation, authorization revalidation, cancellation and terminal-state behavior remain unchanged. The process-local signal relies on the existing enforced single-API-worker architecture; horizontal scaling still requires shared event notification.
- **Verification:** Race-enabled PostgreSQL tests passed for commit-to-SSE wakeup (13.77 ms observed), forced authorization timing, terminal/cancel/admin/graph notification, atomic failure and terminal competition, and team-fragment persistence. The full Go/PostgreSQL race suite and `go vet` passed, along with Pi 47/47, OpenAI Agents 56/56 and the real local dual-worker stack test.
- **Files:** `backend/internal/app/{app,runs,teams,graph_runs,admin,run_event_notify}.go`, notifier/integration tests and backend runtime documentation.

### Fixed — preserve collaboration contracts and metrics during backend integration

- **What changed:** Integrate backend observability and Pi/OpenAI Agents execution with the current HTML deliverable and selected-node collaboration baseline. Preserve the frozen HTML contract for proposal/synthesis, use a persona-preserving critique policy for review turns, and emit collaboration graph/node metrics only after committed state transitions. Replayed completed turns cannot reset later node state. Isolate rounding fixtures so pricing tests do not depend on randomized map iteration.
- **Why:** The two approved histories overlap in graph serialization and migrations; blindly choosing either side would lose HTML validation, review semantics or migration identity checks. Collaboration terminal paths also bypassed the newly introduced metric hooks.
- **Impact:** Existing frontend functionality and both migration-011 histories are preserved. Selected-node collaboration remains separate from nested node teams; no production schema or deployment is changed by this local integration.
- **Verification:** Combined Go/PostgreSQL race, mixed-runtime HTML collaboration dispatch, migration history/identity, transaction rollback and metric replay tests; Pi 47, OpenAI Agents 54, launcher 11 and dual-SDK stack 1; SaaS 375 and broader Canvas/runtime 982 tests (overlapping suites), typecheck/build/vet and independent review. Exact final counts and evidence are in `docs/awwo-main-observability-merge-20260913.md`.
- **Files:** `backend/internal/app/{database,graph_contracts,graph_runs,graph_collaboration}.go`, graph policy/collaboration/migration regression tests, `creator.md` and merge acceptance documentation.

### Added — backend observability and durable invocation usage

- **What changed:** Add private loopback metrics and self-hosted OTLP instrumentation for Go, Pi and OpenAI Agents; persist nullable invocation usage/timing with frozen integer micro-USD pricing; expose four role-scoped usage/observability read APIs and immutable 24h/30d metric snapshots. Reconcile the two historical migration-011 schemas through identified additive migrations 012–014, retain the ledger after completed-canvas deletion, and bind usage pagination to transaction visibility.
- **Why:** Model calls and multi-Agent execution needed measurable backend behavior without turning missing provider usage into zero cost, leaking tenant data, changing historical prices or losing usage when business records are deleted.
- **Impact:** Exporters default off and management ports remain loopback. Reader/member responses omit cost keys; sensitive platform reads are audited. Pricing is operator-supplied estimation, automatic retention deletion is not implemented, and uncertain accepted calls are not replayed. This scope does not deploy monitoring services, frontend RUM, notifications or production infrastructure.
- **Verification:** Full Go/PostgreSQL race passed (121 top-level / 252 including subtests, zero test failures/skips, 137.330s), Pi 47, OpenAI Agents 54, launcher 11 and dual-SDK protocol stack 1 all passed. Final frozen-price/cursor regressions passed (3 top-level / 5 including subtests, 5.492s). Four real gpt-5.6 graphs plus one Computer Use team run completed 12 invocations with reported provider usage; three management scrapes returned 200 and business metrics routes stayed isolated. Actual OTLP verified 12 parent chains, 13 linked asynchronous roots, ledger/window agreement and content privacy. One hundred local health/usage requests had zero errors. Actual provider pricing remains unset; direct browser JSON viewing was client-blocked. See `docs/awwo-backend-observability-acceptance-20260913.md` for five screenshots and exact boundaries.
